description: This file defines the class 'jirasoapInterface', which is an implementation of an interface to interact with Jira's SOAP API for issue tracking integration in TestLink. It includes methods for connecting to Jira, retrieving issues, adding issues, and processing Jira-specific attributes, as well as configuration templates and environment checks.

classes.name: jirasoapInterface
classes.description: A class providing an interface to Jira SOAP API for issue management within TestLink, including connection handling, issue creation, retrieval, and attribute processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Jira SOAP interface, sets configuration, connects to Jira, and prepares necessary status and localization info.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration with default URLs and attributes if missing, and initializes issue defaults.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a Jira issue by issueID, enriching it with status and HTML string representations.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks whether the provided issueID has a valid Jira ID syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a SOAP connection with Jira and authenticates to retrieve status domain and other info.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Jira is established.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a SoapClient instance configured with WSDL and options for communicating with Jira SOAP API.

methods.name: getStatusDomain
methods.description: Returns the domain of available statuses in Jira.

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Configures what Jira statuses are considered 'resolved' based on the configuration.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new Jira issue with a given summary and description, returning the result status.

methods.name: addIssueFromArray
methods.description: Creates a Jira issue from an array of issue data.

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Configures the resolved status mapping from the configuration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Checks if API-based issue creation is supported given the current configuration.

methods.name: processAttributes
methods.description: Processes and loads additional Jira issue attributes from the configuration.

methods.name: getRelaxedAttribute
methods.description: Processes flexible attribute data for Jira issue creation.

methods.name: getCustomFieldsAttribute
methods.description: Processes custom fields for Jira issues from configuration XML data.

methods.name: getAffectsVersionsAttribute
methods.description: Processes affected version information for Jira issues from configuration XML data.
